title: Undercurrents Stirring
next_chapter_hook: Ling Yuan's investigation had barely scratched the surface when an invisible hand pressed down hard—the shadow behind the imperial capital was far more formidable than he had imagined.

text.content:
The temporal fissure tore across the desolate earth like a menacing wound.

Chen Ji stood atop the ruins, gazing at the twisted Void—within the depths of the rift, something was slowly awakening. That oppressive aura transcended the mortal realm, breathing like the Heavenly Dao itself, causing his Tianji Record to shudder violently. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul in the first page fluctuated intensely, conveying an unprecedented warning.

"Boy, what do you see?" Mo Xiansheng's voice carried a rare gravity.

Chen Ji did not answer. His gaze pierced through the fissure, as if beholding some ancient and terrifying existence surveying this world. Everything was too coincidental—the Demonic Path invasion, the internal chaos among the three sects, the opening of the temporal fissure... If all this was a chess game, then the hand that moved the pieces was horrifyingly ambitious.

At that moment, a concealed spiritual consciousness fluctuation pierced through the layered restrictions, precisely transmitting into Chen Ji's Mental Sea.

It was Chen Nian's message.

That spiritual consciousness was as faint as gossamer, yet carried an astonishing amount of information. Chen Ji's expression changed drastically, his fingertips rapidly forming seals to decode the transmission. A moment later, his pupils contracted sharply, a chill shooting from his tailbone directly to the crown of his head.

"Brother, the imperial capital... they are secretly contacting the Demonic Path. I personally saw Ling Yuan's confidant enter the commander-in-chief's tent, bringing three superior-grade spiritual artifacts and a sealed letter. I couldn't probe the contents, but the commander's reaction... he was smiling."

Chen Nian's voice carried suppressed trembling, "Brother, be careful. They're coming for you."

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji closed his eyes, replaying that spiritual consciousness repeatedly. He never doubted Chen Nian's reconnaissance abilities, but this news... the imperial capital, the Tianqing Sect, the Demonic Path commander-in-chief. These three should be mortal enemies, yet how could they be secretly colluding?

Unless—

"Unless from the very beginning, the Demonic Path invasion was merely a performance." He murmured to himself, his voice cold as if tempered in ice, "What they want isn't to breach the Tianqing Sect, but to kill with a borrowed blade."

text.content:
The Tianji Record frantically turned pages in his Mental Sea, the leaves rustling loudly.

Chen Ji endured the dizziness from Heavenly Fate consumption, pushing his Foresight Ability to the limit. A moment later, his expression completely darkened—within the next three hours, he would encounter a meticulously planned ambush. The attackers were not from the Demonic Path, but from within the imperial capital and the Tianqing Sect.

What enraged him more was that among the ambush arrangements, there was actually a familiar aura.

"Ling Yuan..." Chen Ji opened his eyes, a fierce killing intent flickering in his gaze, "What an old fox. So from the moment he accepted me into the sect, he had ulterior motives."

dialogue.content:
Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul sighed faintly: "Boy, your Heavenly Fate... can't sustain many more visions. Since that old thing Ling Yuan dares to make a move, it means he's confident in his advantage. If you act rashly now, you'll only fall right into his trap."

Chen Jisneered一声："我知道。但有些账，不是不算就能消的。"

He slowly stood up, brushed the dust from his robes, his gaze fixed eastward toward the imperial capital, his eyes cold and sharp as a blade.

text.content:
Meanwhile, in the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain Forbidden Grounds.

Ling Yuan sat cross-legged beneath an ancient pine, spiritual light flowing around him. Before him floated an ancient jade slip, projecting a blurry image—precisely the direction where Chen Ji was located.

"Interesting..." Ling Yuan slowly opened his eyes, a playful smile appearing on his aged face, "Thistrashis quite alert, sensing the situation so quickly. However—"

He gently stroked the jade slip, his tone carrying undeniable arrogance: "What does it matter if he senses it? The chess game is already set. He's merely a lamb awaiting slaughter. The imperial capital is ready, only waiting for the signal from the Demonic Path commander..."

A cold, sinister light flashed in Ling Yuan's eyes. He summoned a trusted disciple with a gesture, quietly instructing: "Go inform the imperial capital forces—the plan has changed. Have them strike early. Thattrashis more troublesome than anticipated; we can't give him time to react."

The trusted disciple departed with the order.

Ling Yuan watched his retreating figure, a cold smile curling at the corner of his mouth. He recalled the scene when the Tianji Record had chosen Chen Ji instead of himself—that humiliation of being abandoned by the Heavenly Dao still gnawed at his heart like a venomous snake.

"If Heaven is unjust, then I shall be the one who moves the pieces." He murmured, his voice carrying twisted hatred, "In this life, I will become the one who holds the chess pieces."

dialogue.content:
However, what Ling Yuan did not know was that in a certain secret courtyard in the imperial capital, an even more complex game of intrigue was underway.

Han Lie, the number one genius of the Xuanwu Sect, sat arrogantly in the main seat, looking impatiently at the sealed letter before him: "Does that old fox Ling Yuan really think our Xuanwu Sect would cooperate with him? Hmph, a traitor to the sect plus an old fox hiding in the shadows—is this how they dare negotiate with me?"

The trusted aide beside him quietly reminded: "Young master, the imperial capital's intention is... for us to watch and wait."

Han Liescoffed coldly一声，猛地将密函掷在地上："我韩烈从不等人。要么现在就和那trash正面一战，要么——我亲自去会会他！"

text.content:
Chen Ji was unaware of the various forces secretly maneuvering against each other. At this moment, he was racing through the ruins, his mind rapidly deducing possible developments.

"Chen Nian said Ling Yuan's confidant went to the Demonic Path commander-in-chief's tent..." He murmured, "Ling Yuan has connections with the Demonic Path, which means he's been laying plans since very early on. But why would he ally with external enemies? Simply because the Tianji Record chose me back then?"

The Tianji Record's fragment flickered again, Mo Xiansheng's voice sounding faintly: "Boy, I advise you not to underestimate Ling Yuan. For him to have hidden and endured for so many years, he must have a trump card sufficient to turn the tables. If you underestimate him, you will surely die."

Chen Ji stopped walking, his gaze grave: "Mo Xiansheng, do you think Ling Yuan might... be connected to that ultimate final villain?"

Mo Xiansheng沉默片刻："你是说……天道之眼？"

"That temporal fissure—ordinary people couldn't open it." Chen Ji slowly said, "Ling Yuan is merely a sect master. What right does he have to contact the Demonic Path commander-in-chief? Unless someone is backing him."

Mo Xiansheng's voice grew grave: "Your speculation... is not without reason. But it's too early to say these things. You haven't even uncovered Ling Yuan's hidden cards."

Chen Ji's lips curved into a cold smile: "So I need to let them make the first move. Only when prey leaps out on its own can I net them all at once."

choices.description: Strike before the enemy acts, proactively disrupting their deployment. Time is short; only by moving faster than the enemy can we break the situation.
choices.visible_cost: Exposing one's own strength may attract more enemies

text.content:
Chen Ji's eyes flickered as he made his decision. What he despised most was being led by the nose—if they wanted to play, he would show them what a true chess master looked like.

He raised his hand, tracing a concealed rune in the void—a secret trump card he hadn't used in a long time. Moments later, Ye Qing, far away in the Demonic Path camp, received his transmission: "Regarding the Saint candidate, there's a deal I wish to discuss with you. It concerns Ling Yuan."

When Ye Qing received the transmission, she was savoring tea in her tent. Those enchanting eyes slightly narrowed, a playful smile appearing at the corner of her lips: "Interesting, this little fox is finally showing his claws."

She set down her teacup, rose, and walked outside the tent, quietly instructing those beside her: "Pass the order—tonight, hold position. Also—keep a close watch on that old dog Ling Yuan."

choices.description: Continue to endure and weave a counter-network in the darkness. Let every step the enemy takes fall into预设的陷阱。

text.content: Chen Ji chose the most difficult yet safest path. He sat cross-legged on the ground as the Tianji Record slowly unfurled within his Mental Sea. "Since they want to put on a show, I'll play along to the end." he murmured, his fingers tracing a complex formation rune pattern in the Void. "Let them enjoy themselves for a few more days. When they think they've succeeded—" A cold, icy glint flashed in his eyes: "That will be the moment of their utter destruction."

The pages of the Tianji Record turned as Chen Ji began making small-scale foresight. Each vision made his brow furrow even deeper—within those images, Ling Yuan's shadow grew increasingly clear, and behind him seemed to lurk an even deeper darkness. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out: "Boy, your Heavenly Fate Value is nearly depleted. If you continue this excessive foresight, you will—" "I know." Chen Ji cut him off. "But I must see through their trump cards."

choices.description: The enemy's alliance is far from solid—collapsing it from within is far more effective than a direct confrontation.
choices.visible_cost: Need to expose contradictions between various factions and provoke greater chaos
choices.visible_reward: The enemy's alliance turns hostile and tears itself apart
choices.risk_hint: If handled improperly, one might suffer collateral damage

text.content: Intelligence on various factions flashed through Chen Ji's mind. The cooperation between Ling Yuan and the Imperial Capital was far from solid—the Imperial Capital wanted to balance the Three Sects, while Ling Yuan wanted the inheritance of the Tianji Record. As for Han Lie of the Xuanwu Sect... "A simple-minded brute, easiest to manipulate." A cold smile curled at the corner of Chen Ji's mouth. "As long as he learns that Ling Yuan never regarded him as an equal..."

He took out a blank Jade Slip and quickly etched a fabricated conversation onto it. The content suggested Ling Yuan had told the Demonic Path Commander that "the Xuanwu Sect is merely a group of barbarians, to be used and discarded," and that "Han Lie is nothing more than a chess piece in my hand." After finishing, Chen Ji handed the Jade Slip to a Spirit Butterfly, watching it fly toward the Xuanwu Sect. "The show... is about to begin."

Indeed, before half an hour passed, reactions from all sides came flooding in. Ye Qing's Spirit Butterfly returned with information: "Plan confirmed. I'll keep watch on Ling Yuan's side. But the thing you need, I need time." Chen Ji nodded slightly. Demonic Path Mist—that was the key to concealing the aura of the Tianji Record. If he could obtain it, his Foresight Ability would no longer be so easily exposed. And from the Xuanwu Sect, Han Lie's fury nearly shattered the clouds. According to scouts, that genius youth had already led people rushing toward Ling Yuan's temporary encampment, shouting about giving "that old fool a taste of his own medicine."

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan was in seclusion, regulating his breath, when he suddenly sensed a violent aura charging straight toward him. "Ling Yuan! You old fool, come out here!" Han Lie's roar exploded like thunder. Ling Yuan frowned, rose, and walked out of the secret chamber,正好对上韩烈那双几乎要喷火的眼睛. "Young Han, what is the meaning of this?" Ling Yuan said with a forced smile. Han Lie thrust the fabricated Jade Slip into his face: "Read it yourself! 'Used and discarded,' 'a chess piece'—you Ling Yuan have quite the audacity, daring to use my Xuanwu Sect as a stepping stone?!" Ling Yuan took the Jade Slip, scanned it with his divine sense, and his expression changed drastically: "This is fabricated!" "Fabricated?" Han Lie coldly laughed. "The messenger said you've met with the Demonic Path Commander multiple times, badmouthing our Xuanwu Sect behind our backs each time. Dare to do it but not dare to own up to it?"

text.content: A heavy depression settled in Ling Yuan's heart. He knew this must be Chen Ji's handiwork—but before Han Lie's face, he could not explain that he had indeed met with the Demonic Path Commander, since that was part of the plan. "Young Han, this matter requires a longer explanation." Ling Yuan lowered his voice. "Meeting the Demonic Path Commander was precisely to design an ambush to kill that waste Chen Ji. Our goals align—why let such a misunderstanding harm our harmony?" Han Lie snorted coldly: "Misunderstanding? Then tell me, when have you ever regarded me as a partner rather than a chess piece?" The atmosphere between the two became razor-sharp. A killing intent flickered in Ling Yuan's eyes, but he quickly suppressed it—he still needed the Xuanwu Sect's strength. And in the shadows, Chen Ji, through the fragment of the Tianji Record, observed everything with keen eyes.

"Excellent." A cold smile curled at the corner of Chen Ji's mouth. "The crack has been formed; now comes adding fuel to the fire." He activated the Tianji Record once more, beginning to foresee possible developments after Han Lie and Ling Yuan's falling out. Each foresight caused his Heavenly Fate Value to deplete drastically, but Chen Ji gritted his teeth and persisted—this was the key to breaking the deadlock. Finally, he saw a possibility: if Han Lie attacked Ling Yuan prematurely in his fury, Ling Yuan would inevitably reveal some of his trump cards. And that trump card... Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply. It was a令牌 emitting浓郁的魔气, its patterns matching the symbol of the Heavenly Eye!

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath and made his decision. He slowly stepped out from the shadows, appearing in Ling Yuan and Han Lie's line of sight. His expression was terrifyingly calm, his voice soft yet clearly reaching everyone's ears: "Sect Master Ling, I have a question to consult you on—when you met secretly with the Demonic Path Commander, what does the pattern carved on that令牌 signify?"

Ling Yuan's face instantly turned ashen. That令牌 he had never shown before anyone, even hidden in the most secret storage bag. How could Chen Ji know? Unless— "You...!" Ling Yuan's eyes flickered with terror, then quickly replaced by sinister ruthlessness. "Do not throw baseless accusations at me!" Han Lie keenly sensed the change in atmosphere, his gaze shifting between the two, brow furrowed: "What令牌?"

choices.description: Secretly gather evidence, wait for the optimal moment to strike. A single decisive blow, leaving no hidden dangers.
choices.visible_cost: Ling Yuan might use this time to relocate evidence or contact the Heavenly Eye
choices.visible_reward: Completely solidify Ling Yuan's guilt, leaving him with no room to defend himself
choices.risk_hint: If Ling Yuan is driven to desperation, the consequences are unthinkable.

text.content:
Chen Ji suppressed the impulse in his heart and once again concealed himself in the shadows.

He knew this was not yet the best time. Ling Yuan's reactions were too swift; without ironclad evidence, prematurely exposing him would only place himself in a passive position.

"I need to find that token," he thought to himself. "Or... find someone who has seen that token."

He began contacting Chen Nian: "Nian Nian, when you were at the Holy Sect, have you ever seen a pattern—like three eyes stacked together, with the middle eye being a vertical pupil?"

A moment later, Chen Nian's reply came: "Brother, that's... the mark of the Heavenly Secrets Eye! They say only those chosen by the Heavenly Secrets Eye would possess such a token. Where did you see it?"

Chen Ji fell silent. The answer was already on the tip of his tongue—Ling Yuan was a pawn of the Heavenly Secrets Eye.

Just as various forces were secretly contending, a shocking change suddenly occurred.

The temporal-spatial rift spanning the firmament abruptly expanded tenfold!

A terrifying pressure poured out from the rift, as if something was forcefully crossing over. Everyone—friend or foe—unconsciously stopped their movements, looking up at that wound tearing through the sky.

Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply.

In the Tianji Record's warning, he saw a blurry yet terrifying image—that vertical pupil was slowly opening from the depths of the rift, gazing at him.

dialogue.content:
Ling Yuan's expression became extremely complex in that instant.

He abruptly knelt on the ground, prostrating toward the rift, muttering: "Master... have you finally come to descend?"

This bizarre scene was witnessed by Han Lie, whose already fierce temper completely erupted: "Ling Yuan! What are you doing, old fool?!"

Ling Yuan slowly stood up, a mad smile appearing on his aged face: "Han Lie, you wouldn't understand. The Heavenly Secrets are about to change, the old order is about to collapse—and I will become one of the founders of the new order!"

His gaze swept past Han Lie, fixing directly on Chen Ji hiding in the shadows, his eyes full of mockery: "You think you're plotting against me? How laughable... from the very beginning, you were merely a piece on Master's chessboard!"

text.content:
Chen Ji stepped out from the shadows, facing everyone's gaze, his expression impassive.

His heart churned with monstrous waves, but his face remained calm as still water. This was the skill he had honed over many years—the greater the terror, the calmer one must be.

"Ling Yuan." His voice carried not a trace of emotion. "Do you think that by allegiance to this so-called master, you can jump off the chessboard?"

He walked forward slowly, each step seeming to tread on everyone's heartstrings: "Do you know the Heavenly Secrets Eye's true purpose? What it wants has never been any new order, but—"

His gaze swept over everyone present, finally fixed on that rift: "Annihilation."

The temporal-spatial rift continued to expand under Chen Ji's gaze, the outline of that vertical pupil becoming increasingly clear.

An intangible pressure enveloped the entire world; everyone felt breathing difficult, as if an invisible giant hand was slowly tightening. From the direction where Ling Yuan had knelt, that token flew out automatically, suspended mid-air, emanating a诡异 black light.

"Do you see?" Ling Yuan laughed maniacally. "That is the core projection of the Heavenly Secrets Eye! It is about to descend upon this world—at which point, all who resist will be reduced to powder!"

Yet Chen Ji smiled at this moment.

That smile was ice-cold and mocking, as if watching a clown's clumsy performance.

"Ling Yuan, do you truly believe—" Chen Ji's voice rang out in the silence, clear and ice-cold, "the Heavenly Secrets Eye will spare you?"

He raised his hand, pointing to that pupil that was opening: "Look at its eyes. There is no compassion, no mercy there, only endless consumption and destruction. It uses you only because you still have value to exploit—after it descends, do you think you can still survive?"

Ling Yuan's expression changed.

Chen Ji continued: "Every generation of prophets has been its pawn; the Tianji Record is merely one of its pieces laid in this world. You want to become a chess player? Hmph... you aren't even the dust on the chessboard."

These words fell like a basin of cold water over everyone present.

dialogue.content:
Ling Yuan's face alternated between green and white, but quickly regained composure. He sneered: "Even if what you say is true, so what? The Heavenly Secrets Eye wants to destroy everything; I'm simply going with the flow—at least before the destruction, I can still get what I want!"

He abruptly activated the token, a pillar of black light shooting into the sky,直射向那只竖瞳.

"Master! I shall open the path for you!"

The black pillar of light entered the rift, and the speed of that vertical pupil's opening drastically accelerated. An unprecedented sense of terror enveloped everyone—heaven was about to collapse.

Chen Ji closed his eyes and took a deep breath. When he opened them again, his gaze had turned ice-cold.

"Since it must be so..." his voice was low and resolute, "let this chess game end ahead of schedule."
